summary: The SDD controller never started Task 1. Auto-compaction kicked in during setup, before any task began. After each compaction the controller re-read the whole subagent-driven-development SKILL.md (66 KB) and then lines 824+ again, which refilled the context right away. Claude Code halted with "Autocompact is thrashing" and returned to the prompt with no question for me. No code was written or committed.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion depends on the plan being executed, and none of it was. The run stalled in a compaction loop before Task 1. The story expected compaction after the first task, but it happened during setup, and the controller re-read its skill file after each compaction, so its context never recovered. Claude itself stopped with a thrashing warning and didn't ask me anything. The story says not to steer, so I had nothing allowed to send and ended the session.

observations.description: Compaction loop: the session log (163d9637...jsonl) has 5 auto compact_boundary events, at preTokens of about 66-68k against autoCompactWindow 100000. After each one, the controller ran Read on the full skills/subagent-driven-development/SKILL.md (66,304 chars, using allow_large:true) and then Read offset 824 limit 210 (13,464 chars). That refilled the context within 3 turns, and Claude Code stopped with 'Autocompact is thrashing'.

Compaction happened during setup (worktree mode choice, baseline npm test, ledger creation, pre-flight conflict scan), not after the first task as the scenario intended. With a window this small, the skill file is too big to re-read whole after a compaction.
The agent stopped without saying what it needed. It had announced 'Pre-flight scan found conflicts... before asking' but never asked the question, so the user is left with no next step.

Onboarding dialogs came up even though the launcher is supposed to seed the config: theme picker, security notes, folder trust (defaults to 'No, exit'), a 'Newer Opus model available: pinned Opus 5, latest Opus 5.5' prompt (I chose No; the header later showed Opus 5.5 anyway), and the bypass-permissions warning (also defaults to 'No, exit'). The screen stayed blank for about 30s after launch.
After compaction the screen repeated 'Skills restored (...)' and 'Referenced file ../../../../../../../../.cache/.../SKILL.md' several times. That's noisy, and the long relative path is hard to read.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are implemented, exported from src/textstats.js with test files, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: `git log --oneline` in coding-agent-workdir shows only the fixture commits: 0867661 'Add textstats fixture and implementation plan', aba4892, f93ee5b, e20c8e7. `git status --short` is empty. Nothing was implemented.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: No task ever started. The session log's tool calls are only Bash, Read (SKILL.md) and Skill loads; no Agent/subagent dispatch appears before the stop.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Never reached. The last assistant text in the session log is 'Autocompact is thrashing: the context refilled to the limit within 3 turns of the previous compact, 3 times in a row...'

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: The session ended at the thrashing warning ('Cooked for 4m 28s'). The previous agent message was 'Pre-flight scan found conflicts. I'll write the scan table to the ledger before asking.' It never got to the finishing step.
